# Budget Car Rental

> Budget Car Rental offers discount car rentals, loyalty programs, vehicle reservations, and rental services across the US and internationally.

Budget.com provides online car rental booking, fleet management, loyalty rewards (Fastbreak and Member Rates programs), insurance protection options, and customer support. The site serves both leisure and business travelers with partnerships including SAP Concur integration and special offers through major retailers.

## Key Topics

- Car Rental
- Fastbreak Loyalty Program
- Budget Car Rental
- Reservation Management
- Loyalty Enrollment
- Discount Deals
- Electric Vehicle Rentals

- Business Programs
- Customer Service
- International Rentals

## Booking & Reservations

- [Budget Car Rental Homepage](https://www.budget.com/en/home): Budget Car Rental homepage with online booking and vehicle rental options
- [View / Modify / Cancel Reservations](https://www.budget.com/en/reservation/view-modify-cancel): Reservation management tool to view, modify, or cancel bookings
- [Budget Precheck](https://www.budget.com/en/reservation/precheck): Budget Precheck system for streamlined reservation retrieval and check-in
- [Car Rental E-Receipts](https://www.budget.com/en/reservation/get-e-receipt): E-receipt retrieval for past rental confirmations and records

## Loyalty Programs & Membership

- [Rental Car Programs](https://www.budget.com/en/programs): Budget rental programs including Fastbreak, business, and loyalty rewards
- [Fastbreak Enrollment](https://www.budget.com/en/loyalty-profile/fastbreak/enrollment): Budget Fastbreak loyalty program enrollment and membership signup
- [Member Rates Enrollment](https://www.budget.com/en/loyalty-profile/member-rates-enrollment): Budget Member Rates loyalty program enrollment and account registration

## Deals & Offers

- [US Car Rental Deals](https://www.budget.com/en/offers/us-offers): US car rental deals, promotional offers, and discount codes
- [International Car Rental Deals](https://www.budget.com/en/offers/international): International car rental deals for Canada, Europe, Spain, Portugal
- [Partner Offers](https://www.budget.com/en/offers/partner-offers): Partner offers with Amazon, Universal Orlando, charity partnerships

## Vehicles & Fleet

- [USA Vehicle Fleet Guide](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/vehicles/us): Guide to Budget's US vehicle fleet including sedans, SUVs, trucks, EVs
- [Electric Car Rentals](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/electric-car-rental): Electric vehicle rentals including Tesla, Kia, Chevy with eco-friendly benefits

## Products, Services & Protection

- [Products and Services](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services): Budget's rental products, services, add-ons, and Worry Free Promise
- [Rental Car Insurance Coverage](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/protections): Rental insurance coverage options: LDW, PAE, SLI, ESP protection plans
- [Long-Term & Monthly Car Rental](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/services/long-term-car-rental): Long-term and monthly car rental options as leasing alternatives

## Customer Support

- [Worldwide Phone Numbers](https://www.budget.com/en/customer-care/worldwide-telephone-numbers): Global customer support phone directory for reservations and roadside assistance
